ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What term describes nurse sharks in this ecosystem?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a food web titled “FOOD WEB”. On the right side it is labeled “Nurse Shark”, and it is connected to other organisms through multiple blue feeding arrows, such as shrimp, reef lobster, flat fish, and fan worm; the image also has producers such as Golden Algae and Turtle Grass. Reasoning: The question asks what term is used to describe nurse sharks in this ecosystem. According to food web rules, animals that eat other organisms are called predators. Nurse shark is in an animal feeding relationship, so it should be described as a predator.
